title: NPV by start year from a benefit stream
heading: NPV by Start Year Is One Cash Flow, Shifted and Discounted to One Date
cases: the table has one whole-$k entry for each start in each window, and a project with costs only, started in the first plan year, is worth minus its discounted costs
the whole table matches the reference, with benefits that fall after the plan's last year still counted
every start is valued on the first plan year, so a later start of the same cash flow is worth less
benefits begin in the year after the last year of work
the decay counts the years of delay past the project's own earliest start, not past the plan's first year
